tabs.description: Allows the extension to access browser tabs and read browsing activity.
tabs.mitigation: Grant only if the extension needs to interact with tabs.

history.description: Allows access to the user's browsing history.
history.mitigation: Avoid installing extensions that request this unless absolutely necessary.

cookies.description: Allows access to cookies which may contain session and login information.
cookies.mitigation: Extensions should avoid accessing cookies unless required for authentication.

storage.description: Allows the extension to store data locally in the browser.
storage.mitigation: Ensure sensitive data is encrypted before storage.

webRequest.description: Allows interception and modification of network requests.
webRequest.mitigation: Use only trusted extensions with this permission.

activeTab.description: Allows temporary access to the currently active tab when the user interacts with the extension.
activeTab.mitigation: Generally safe but should still be limited.

downloads.description: Allows the extension to manage and download files.
downloads.mitigation: Ensure downloads are from trusted sources.

clipboardRead.description: Allows reading data from the clipboard which may contain sensitive information.
clipboardRead.mitigation: Avoid extensions requesting clipboard access unnecessarily.

clipboardWrite.description: Allows writing data to the clipboard.
clipboardWrite.mitigation: Use trusted extensions to prevent malicious clipboard modifications.

notifications.description: Allows the extension to display notifications to the user.
notifications.mitigation: Check if notifications are necessary for extension functionality.
